title: The Legend of the First Poisoner
text: When the heavens were new and still learning their own rules, a physician named Lan-yi walked the earth curing plagues. In the seventh year she found a village where no plague had ever come — and no laughter, either. The elder told her: 'We let one child of each generation eat the bitter root. That one is sickly, and dies young, and in exchange the rest are well.' Lan-yi wept, and refused her cures, and sat by the cold hearth of the chosen child for nine nights. On the tenth she rose and said: 'There is no cure for what you have chosen. But I will teach you to name it.' And she drew from her sleeve five small creatures — viper, centipede, toad, spider, scorpion — and set them loose, and walked away. The Five Poisons Sect remembers her as the first who refused to lie about the price.

title: The Oath of the Grey
text:
We are not the righteous; we do not pretend that kindness is enough.
We are not the demonic; we do not pretend that cruelty is the only truth.
We are the grey — which is to say, we have eyes.
We strike when striking is the only honest answer.
We heal when healing is the only honest answer.
We do not apologise for the strike.
We do not boast of the healing.
